mcqs.keyword: Theme and background of World Wetlands Day
mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about World Wetlands Day 2026 and its background:
1. The 2026 theme was “Wetlands and traditional knowledge: Celebrating cultural heritage”.
2. The Ramsar Convention was adopted on 2 February 1997.
3. World Wetlands Day has been observed since 1997.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The Ramsar Convention was adopted on 2 February 1971, not 1997; 1997 is the year since which World Wetlands Day has been observed.

mcqs.question: What was the theme of World Pulses Day 2026?
options: Pulses of the World: From Modesty to Excellence
Women in Science: Catalysing Viksit Bharat
mcqs.explanation: The theme of World Pulses Day 2026 was “Pulses of the World: From Modesty to Excellence”. The other options were themes associated with World Radio Day, International Mother Language Day and National Science Day respectively.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II in the context of February 2026 observances.

List-I
 a. World Pulses Day — International Year of Pulses
 b. World Pulses Day — Declaration of the observance
 c. Global Tourism Resilience Day — Organisation associated with the day
 d. Global Tourism Resilience Day — Headquarters and year of establishment

List-II
 i. UN Tourism
 ii. 2016
 iii. Madrid, established in 1975
 iv. United Nations General Assembly, December 2018

Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iv, c-i and d-iii. The International Year of Pulses was 2016; World Pulses Day was declared by the United Nations General Assembly in December 2018; Global Tourism Resilience Day is associated with UN Tourism, headquartered in Madrid and established in 1975.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The theme of World Radio Day 2026 was “Radio and Artificial Intelligence”.
Reason (R): The message associated with the observance was “AI is a tool, not a voice”.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both Assertion and Reason are true. The stated theme and the message are separate elements of World Radio Day 2026; the message does not explain why that particular theme was selected.
